_comment: Code-graph feature details — lógica interna, flujo de datos, y arquitectura de cada feature.

cg-parser-infra.name: Parser Infrastructure (tree-sitter)
logic_flow: Match por Language enum: Rust → RustParser, TypeScript/JavaScript → TypeScriptParser, Python → PythonParser, Go → GoParser, Java → JavaParser, C → CParser, Cpp → CppParser
Cada parser implementa new() → set_language() → parse(source, file_path) → Vec<Symbol>
parse() interno: parser.parse(source_bytes) → Tree → extract_symbols(tree, source, file_path) recursivo
compact_node_signature(): extrae signature truncando body (reemplaza { ... }), limita a 400 chars en boundary Unicode
cyclomatic_complexity(): cuenta if/while/for/loop/match/switch/case/catch + operadores booleanos (&&/||/and/or), base 1.0
cg-parser-infra.error_handling: GraphError::TreeSitter, GraphError::Parser — cada parser captura errores de set_language y parse
cg-parser-infra.coverage: 100% — todos los lenguajes tienen al menos 1 test de integración

cg-parser-rust.name: Rust Parser
logic_flow: Parser tree-sitter para Rust con LANGUAGE = tree_sitter_rust::LANGUAGE
extract_symbols_from_node() recursivo con pattern matching en kind de tree-sitter:
function_item | function_declaration → SymbolKind::Function o Method (si parent existe)
impl_item → SymbolKind::Impl, nombre extraído de child 'type' (impl Trait for Struct → Struct, impl Struct → Struct)
impl_item navega recursivamente en children declaration_list para extraer métodos con parent = impl_name
push_symbol(): extrae posición (start/end row+1, column), complexity (solo para Function/Method), signature via compact_node_signature()
cg-parser-rust.coverage: Cubre funciones async/pub, structs, enums, impl blocks con métodos, let con pattern destructuring, compact signatures, Unicode truncation

cg-parser-typescript.name: TypeScript/JavaScript Parser
logic_flow: tree-sitter-typescript con LANGUAGE_TYPESCRIPT o LANGUAGE_TSX según extensión
lexical_declaration (const/let) → Constant o Variable child según pattern sea identifier o no
arrow_function → Function (solo toplevel, detecta si es variable assignment vs declaration)
Misma firma push_symbol() que RustParser: posición, complexity (Function/Method), compact signature
cg-parser-typescript.coverage: Import, Class, Function, Enum, Const, Variable, Arrow function

cg-parser-python.name: Python Parser
logic_flow: class_definition → Class, recorre body recursivamente para methods con parent=className
function_definition → Function (toplevel) o Method (dentro de class). Async functions detectadas por parent
assignment → Variable (incluye tuple destructuring como x, y = (1,2))
Misma lógica push_symbol(): position, signature compacta, complexity (Function/Method)
cg-parser-python.coverage: Import, Class, Method (async def), Variable, tuple destructuring, parent tracking

cg-parser-go.name: Go Parser
logic_flow: import_declaration → iteración de import_spec_list → Import por cada path
method_declaration → Method con receiver type como parent
cg-parser-go.coverage: Import, Struct, Method (con receiver parent), Function, Constant, Variable

cg-parser-java.name: Java Parser
logic_flow: method_declaration → Method (con parent = className si está dentro de class_body)

cg-parser-c.name: C Parser
logic_flow: preproc_include → Import (string_literal o system_lib_string como nombre)

cg-parser-cpp.name: C++ Parser
logic_flow: class_specifier → Class (navega body para methods con parent)
cg-parser-cpp.coverage: Function, Class, Method (parent tracking), Module (namespace), Import

cg-fts5-search.name: FTS5 Full-Text Search with BM25
logic_flow: Schema: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE search_code USING fts5(name, file_path, signature, content='symbols', content_rowid='id')
Triggers: symbols_ai (AFTER INSERT → insert into fts5), symbols_ad (AFTER DELETE → delete), symbols_au (AFTER UPDATE → delete+insert)
Si query vacía → fallback LIKE '%' scan (FTS5 no acepta empty string)
Si no → FTS5 MATCH con phrasify (escapa comillas, envuelve en comillas dobles para multi-word)
BM25 ranking con pesos: name=10.0, file_path=1.0, signature=2.0
FTS5 no garantiza 'exact match first' → re-sort con calculate_score() overlay
calculate_score(): exact=10, prefix=5, contains=1, fuzzy=1, 0 si no match
truncate(limit), arma QueryResult { symbols, total, query_time_ms }
Fallback: si FTS5 table no existe (legacy DB) → LIKE '%query%' scan
cg-fts5-search.coverage: Exact match, fuzzy, case-insensitive, empty query, no results, limit, FTS5 signature column match

cg-edge-detection.name: Edge Detection & Call Graph
logic_flow: EdgeTypes: Calls, Defines, Uses, Imports, Exports, Contains, References, Extends, Implements, TypeOf, Returns, Instantiates, Overrides, Decorates
Si es Import → file → module:name con Imports (confidence=0.8)
2. Por cada caller, extrae symbol_source_slice() (líneas del body)
a. Detecta .methodName( → method call pattern → true
b. Detecta name( con word boundary check (prev char no es alphanumeric/underscore)
c. Previene falsos: init ≠ initialize(, run ≠ // we run(, excluye method calls del path directo
4. Si match → Calls (confianza 0.65) + References (confianza 0.55) con metadata JSON {callee: name}
cg-edge-detection.limitations: Heurístico — no usa tree-sitter para call expressions. Puede tener falsos positivos en strings/comentarios y falsos negativos en calls indirectos.
cg-edge-detection.coverage: Indexing de Rust+Python con edge detection + hub_nodes verificados

cg-query-engine.name: Query Engine with Caching
logic_flow: QueryEngine struct: { db: Arc<CodeGraphDB>, cache: Option<Arc<QueryCache>> }
search(query, limit): cache lookup → db.find_symbols → cache store
QueryCache: { cache: RwLock<HashMap<String, (Instant, QueryResult)>>, ttl, max_entries }
get(): verifica TTL, retorna None si expirado
set(): evicta si max_entries alcanzado, primero por TTL, luego oldest
search_by_pattern(pattern): mapea strings tipo 'function_definition' → SymbolKind → find_by_kind
traverse(): queue con (node, depth), seen_nodes/seen_edges HashSet, evita file:/module: nodes para expansión
resolve_symbol_id(): detecta si es SHA-256 hex (64 chars) o busca por nombre, retorna stable_id
hubs(min_degree): SQL COUNT aggregation en edges, incoming+outgoing, LIMIT
hotspots(min_complexity): risk = complexity × (incoming + 1), ORDER BY risk DESC, LIMIT
cg-query-engine.coverage: Edge traversal (forward+reverse), find_by_kind, limit, query metadata, by_language

cg-path-tracing.name: Cypher-like Path Tracing
logic_flow: Anchor: SELECT target_column FROM edges WHERE source_column = ?
Recursive: SELECT e.target FROM edges e JOIN path_cte p ON e.source = p.current_symbol WHERE depth < max_depth
Retorna Vec<TraversalPath> con target_symbol, depth, path_str (concatenación ' -> ')
cg-path-tracing.coverage: No hay test directo para trace_path — solo indirecto vía test_graph_queries_follow_edges

cg-hubs-hotspots.name: Hub Nodes & Complexity Hotspots
logic_flow: FROM symbols s LEFT JOIN (SELECT to_symbol, COUNT(*) FROM edges) incoming LEFT JOIN (SELECT from_symbol, COUNT(*) FROM edges) outgoing
WHERE incoming+outgoing >= min_degree ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT limit
WHERE complexity >= min_complexity ORDER BY risk DESC, complexity DESC
cg-hubs-hotspots.coverage: No tests directos — solo verificado por code audit

cg-incremental-indexing.name: Incremental Indexing Support
logic_flow: clear_by_file(file_path): DELETE FROM edges/refs/imports/symbols WHERE file_path = ?
ON CONFLICT(stable_id) DO UPDATE — upsert en insert_symbol
normalize_symbol_for_insert(): genera deterministic_id si stable_id es None
4. insert_symbols() + insert_edges() con upsert por stable_id
Actualmente: Indexer::index() hace clear() completo y reindexa TODO — no usa clear_by_file

cg-watcher.name: File Watcher (AutoSync)
logic_flow: Por cada path → debug!("File changed, queuing incremental sync: {:?}", path)
⚠️ NO implementa la re-indexación. Sólo logging.
Lo que falta: conectar eventos a clear_by_file() + parse_file() + insert_symbols()
Sugerencia: debounce de 500ms para evitar re-indexar durante writes parciales

cg-benchmarks.name: Performance Benchmarks
logic_flow: setup_large_db(): inserta 1000 symbols (function_0 a function_999) en in-memory SQLite
cg-benchmarks.notes: Benchmarks usan #[test] no #[bench] — son smoke tests de performance, no benchmarks precisos con criterion

cg-http-server.name: HTTP Server (Sidecar)
logic_flow: CLI: clap Parser con flags: --token (CODE_GRAPH_TOKEN), --port (CODE_GRAPH_PORT, default 8080), --host (CODE_GRAPH_HOST, default 0.0.0.0), --db-path (CODE_GRAPH_DB_PATH)
Subcommands: Serve (default), Scan {path}, Find {query, limit}, Stats
non-loopback → generate_ephemeral_token() (xorshift128 PRNG con nanos+pid seed)
CORS: CODE_GRAPH_ALLOWED_ORIGINS env, comma-separated, default localhost:*, * para permissive
Auth middleware: constant_time_eq(header_token, server_token), evita timing leak
Rechaza null bytes y control chars
cg-http-server.coverage: Sin tests HTTP — solo verificado por code audit

cg-debug-cli.name: Debug CLI (DOT export, verify, list)
logic_flow: list_symbols(kind: Option<String>) → kind filter (function/struct/class/enum/module default=function) → find_by_kind(1000) → 'file:line - name'
verify() → stats() y checa: total_symbols > 0, total_files > 0, retorna OK/error

cg-spawn-blocking.name: Async I/O — spawn_blocking para Indexer
logic_flow: Problema actual: Indexer::index() usa tokio::spawn para parse_file()
std::fs::read_to_string(file_path) — I/O blocking en thread async
parse_source() — CPU-bound parsing en thread async
Impacto: libera el thread de Tokio para seguir manejando otras tareas async
